data.revised_prompt:
Create a single 1536x1024 PNG sprite sheet for a 2D game character using the first provided image as the exact character identity reference and the second provided image only as an invisible layout guide reference. Character: Jay J, the Dragon Prince elite enemy. Preserve the same blue dragon head, white horn crown, sharp angular snout, cyan fins, gold-and-white royal armor, deep blue cloak/fins, white shoulder armor, jewel accents, confident elite enemy personality, and polished game sprite rendering style. Do not redesign into human form or chibi. Match the existing sprite style: clean HD, pixel-inspired crisp edges, readable silhouette, saturated aquatic blue/cyan/white/gold palette, polished RPG enemy avatar look.

Canvas/background: full solid flat #FF00FF magenta everywhere, including between frames and margins. No text, no labels, no UI, no numbers, no watermarks, no visible grid lines, no borders, no guide boxes, no center marks, no safe rectangles, no background textures.

Layout: exactly 12 frames arranged in a 3 rows x 4 columns grid, equal frame slots, centered composition, safe padding, invisible spacing based on the second reference image. Each frame must be centered in its cell with clear magenta margin on every side. Nothing may touch or cross cell edges. Keep the character scale consistent across all frames.

Animation concept: elite-rank attack sequence called “Royal Dragon Verdict”. Strong, controlled, regal, powerful. Add attached FX only near Jay; keep his body large and readable. Use bright cyan dragonfire, white-hot core, gold royal sigils, deep blue shadow flame, small pearl sparks, and a short spiral card-vortex motif represented only by abstract card-shaped light shards. No readable cards or full card faces.

Frame order, left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
1. Calm battle stance, eyes focused, faint cyan aura around horns.
2. Shoulders lower, claw/hand or snout draws in blue motes, small gold sigil begins behind Jay.
3. Wind-up grows, cloak/fins lift, cyan flame coils around the forearm and jaw.
4. Royal charge frame, white horn crown glows, circular gold sigil and tiny abstract card shards spiral inward.
5. First release, Jay lunges slightly forward, compact dragonfire arc forms from mouth/claw.
6. Stronger release, blue-white flame thickens, angular claw mark appears in front of Jay.
7. Peak impact, brightest frame: royal dragonfire burst plus gold sigil flare, powerful but still inside cell.
8. Shockwave pulse, flame curls outward then starts collapsing, white-hot center fades to cyan.
9. Follow-through, Jay's head and shoulders settle, trailing blue flame ribbons sweep back.
10. Afterimage frame, gold sigil fragments and tiny pearl sparks drift near Jay.
11. Recovery, aura dims, Jay returns to poised elite stance with a last cyan horn glow.
12. Loop-ready settle, almost same silhouette as frame 1, only faint residual royal spark.

Important: every frame must contain the same Jay character identity, with all horns, armor, cloak, tail/fin tips, energy, flames, sparks, and smoke fully inside the cell. Keep the effect compact and attached to Jay. Style must be a polished game sprite sheet, not painterly, not realistic, not a wide-screen effect. Use the first reference image as the character model and the second reference image only for the invisible 3x4 sheet spacing and framing.
